searchText: This server isn't the right place for this sort of content. Remember, this is an R&D server. Arguably it's related to R&D since Chris is pointing out that liquid staking platforms have a chance to go bust too, which would greatly affect Ethereum but... R&D? You're saying it's arguably relevant to core protocol R&D. Where is the elaboration on the arguments? It gives a hint that withdrawals should be pushed as soon as possible Liquid staking as it is was always a hole in Ethereum’s decentralization They could start dumping all their lido tokens and cause a panic which will lead to unknown consequences And given that Lido is 30% of Ethereum, this is important I have no idea what is the point in trying to attack me every time I post anything here that is hinting flaws in the current consensus setup of Ethereum, you start arguments all the times in what I suspect attempts to defend Ethereum as it is. But we should not deny flaws here, we should fix them. That’s what R&D is all about. It isn’t a place for arguments You attacked me here Here And now here All is ok? I did not make this connection from the "Alameda is dumping LDO" post, at all. Otherwise I agree that withdrawals enable pool stakers to move their stake, without causing a depegging or panic bank-run-type scenario. Agreed, but this is a place for technical discussion on R&D. Not smart contract hacks, not depegging of stable coins, or even depegging of liquid staking derivatives I would say. All very interesting, this Discord is just not the place for discussing it. You acknowledged that I was correcting you, and now you say I was attacking you? Same for this one Thanks for converting this chat to “pietjepuk arguing with Alex” Definitely not R&D, so I will not respond to any of your messages on that matter. Cool
